comment: The SDK the lock files were written with. CI and the Dockerfile run exactly this version, in the
sdk:10.0.302 image, and restore in locked mode.
rollForward 'feature' lets any newer .NET 10 SDK build it too, so a machine without a 10.0.3xx SDK is
not refused, and such an SDK writes the same lock files: the one package that follows the SDK's own
version, the implicit Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Internal.Assets, is pinned in DungeonTable.Web.csproj.
Bump this, the Dockerfile's and the workflows' SDK tags, that pin and Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing
together, then regenerate the lock files with `dotnet restore --force-evaluate`.
